live_measurement.method: New complete checkpoint lines observed every second; excludes all pre-existing/replayed answers. Fixed-window counts have boundary uncertainty. Interarrival rates exclude the first partial question; observation resolution about one second.

wrapper_microbenchmark.method: CPU-only dummy generation and real checkpoint wrapper; 5 alternating-order trials of 100 new answers on same reports filesystem. Uses full latest medium-video telemetry/sampling payload and real TempCompass source-row identity. Measures added wrapper/JSON/tail-read/fsync cost, not inference, actual worker latency, or scheduler contention.

limitations: Cross-suite tokens/second is a workload-normalized consistency check, not a matched-input A/B equivalence test.
Historical TempCompass wall throughput includes setup/profiling; fresh VideoMME attempt averages include setup/replay time in denominator, but exclude replayed answers from numerator.
One worker per GPU still means two workers sharing host CPU resources.
Wrapper microbenchmark uses dummy generation with real telemetry/sampling payload; it is not an in-worker profiler.
